title: Bartsch to Müller, 29 July/8 August 1629
author: Jacob Bartsch
summary: Bartsch sends Kepler's *Sportula* and announces that he will pass through Leipzig on his way to Frankfurt and Strasbourg.

notes.note: Kepler's *Sportula genethliacis missa* (1629), a short astrological work, printed on his own press at Sagan.
